Awawa, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF…!
Awawawawa, wawa!
#C236196003Jinako#CDEF is panicking.
…which finally means the end to this long, irritating floor.

All of these Labyrinth signs obviously
came from #C236196003Jinako#CDEF, though…

Yep. #C236196003Jinako#CDEF is being steered by the unseen
hand of #RUBS a god#RUBE#C236196003BB#CDEF#REND! I'm just being used here!

I get it.
Then―――
Kindly hand over your SG.

No way!
That means I'll be throwing, I'll lose!
If I give up, it's game over!

Basically, ALL those #C236196003Jinako#CDEF waiting up ahead
are disgrace incarnate.
I wanna do whatever it takes to stop them!
In response, #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF's demeanor changes slightly.

K-#C236196003Karna#CDEF…
I'm pretty sure I didn't ask you to come out.

That was an apology… I suppose.
I felt no offense or arrogance in it.
He's downcast, and truly remorsefully so.

Here he comes, Master!
Stay alert as you can!

Pfft. Overpowered, totally overpowered…!
#C236196003Karna#CDEF's no boring-old lancer with THIS power.

What…?
A… #C000246204Launcher#CDEF…?
Yet another special class appears!

Ha. A fitting class name, is it not?
As your Master says, have you not been hiding
the ultimate bullet of light from us…?

…he's strong.
So sharp, so heavy.

It's unfair how accurate he is,
how cut-and-dry unmerciful he is.
With one fierce move,
he completely exposed our own weaknesses.

Anyway, there's no doubting that we won.
MAN, is my Servant strong or what?
You're STRONG, #C236196003Karna#CDEF!

So this means I can treat myself, right!?
At last, Jersey pudding, right?

Though I don't know how that old muscle-brain
#C236196003Gatou#CDEF does it!
…hey, where IS the old man?

Haha!
So you admit defeat?

#C236196003Jinako#CDEF's words are always wrapped up in a shell.
However―

The truth is, she wanted me to find out.
Those lies were like a key to her room of truth.

Everyone lies.
Anyone who doesn't lie is probably
someone who has nothing dear to themself.

I have to lie――
I'm just someone whose "precious self"
is made up of A BUNCHED-UP PILE OF LIES!

Because I, I am…
a big, fat liar…!
#C236196003Karna#CDEF silently gauges his vanished Master.

He's still on the same floor,
having used up his means of returning.

What's wrong, Praetor?
Let's #C000246204continue onward#CDEF!

Don't worry. I'll protect you, Darling.
So, continue on #C000246204ahead#CDEF.

Surely you're not telling me that you're
frightened? Even you understand that stopping
here is impermissible, yes?

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF. After you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
please have yourself a rest in your
private room.
Even in cyberspace, you need proper rest.

Once you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,

I'll bet you're exhausted, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.

#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF, return to base for now.
Let's discuss our plan
in the #C000246204Student Council Room#CDEF.

#C236196003Sakura#CDEF's worried state gets across to
me even over the transmission.

She's right, it would be best if
we returned to the #C000246204Old School Building#CDEF.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF. Let's return to the
#C000246204Old School Building#CDEF for the time being.
We can come again after we recover.

We got the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Mission complete.
Let's head home and get some rest.

Where are you going? We secured the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
There's nothing urgent to tend to.
Back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF, now.

Hrrrm? Where are you going, #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF? Where are you going,
leaving me behind?

For a second there, I was thinking about
leaving #C236196003Gatou#CDEF and heading back,
but it probably won't rest easy on my conscience,
so let's turn back.

Wait, Praetor. If we're going to head back,
it'll behoove us for the future to have
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF activated.

Master, let's look for the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
It should be around here somewhere…

We don't need to walk all the way back.
We can use the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF to reach the
old school in a flash. Very nifty.

M-my stomach is at its limit…
I want to hurry back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest…

Before we go to the next floor,
let's #C000246204head back to the Student Council Room#CDEF.
We need to hand over the data we got from #C236196003Green Archer#CDEF.
He gave his life to entrust us with it.

Huh? You're still in the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF?
Come on, there's nothing to do there.
Get your butt back here!

We'll talk about what comes next tomorrow,
so #C000246204come back and get some rest#CDEF.
After, drop by the Student Council Room.

We're in a race against time.
We need to hurry to the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF――!

I can't let #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's hopes go to waste.
Let's press on so we can catch up to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!

Praetor, I've grown tired. Let us return
to My Room and have ourselves a bath.

I know how you feel, but knowing
when to rest is also part of the battle.
Let's head back to My Room.

Darling, now is the time for rest.
Let's return to our room and
recover our strength.

What an impatient #[man][woman]#. Laboring away
is not all there is to life, you know?
When it's time to rest, rest.

I was on alert in case she might teleport away,
but it seems she can't this time around.
Y-you've got the wrong person! Wrong person!

I'm actually #C236196003Jinako#CDEF's twin little sister,
Jimeko. Whaddup. Thanks for putting up
with #C236196003Jinako#CDEF all this time.

…we meet, and she starts trying to
fool us in a cringeworthy way.

I see, wrong person, huh?
Okay, I believe you.
Well then, that's that.

It matters not to me whether you're her little
sister, older sister, or cousin. I'm making
SOMEONE with her face take responsibility.

Hrm, we're in a pickle now, Darling. This
excuse is so poor that it makes me want to
start asking a few more questions.

Hmph. Let's get one thing straight, "Jimeko."
Neither the mongrel or I recall ever putting
up with #C236196003Jinako#CDEF even once.

―――Ah, not buying it, huh!
Oh, well… The truth is that I was forced
to say all this, and it's even a pain for me.

S-sure, those signs are #C236196003Jinako#CDEF #ROFS0002#RUBS  productions#RUBEhandicrafts#REND,
but never in a million years
did I expect them to annoy you―――

It was an honest oopsies,
I didn't have the slightest bad intention.
My head is starting to hurt more and more.

But if we can settle things without fighting,
I agree, that would be the best outcome……

So you get me, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF? Man, you've been
barking up the wrong gal. So now if you
could just reel in that sketch Servant.

Among all the #C236196003Jinako#CDEF, I'm the most popular
and have #RUBS relatively#RUBEa very#REND social disposition, see?
That's how it is.

And besides, #C236196003Jinako#CDEF ain't got the slightest
clue what an "#C000246204SG#CDEF" is. Is it like, spicy? Can't
give you something without knowin' what it is.

I think it's something that's too
much to be asking for.
#C236196003Jinako#CDEF, frightened, shrinks back.

―――And at the same time,
her "lance" makes his appearance.
The sense of who was in control completely shifts.

I sense #C236196003#SVT#CDEF get defensive,
and nervously #SVT[snap up straight][stir as if gulping a dry throat][lift her ears and tail straight up][add in non-existent dialog]#.

His feet are positioned half a step more ahead than usual,
and his unaffectedly hanging fingertips are faintly exerted.

I―――might be interpreting this wrong,
but he seems to have made motions toward
protecting his Master, #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF.

Those words deviate from how you
truly feel, Master.

They paid to challenge this Labyrinth, in the
sum of fair danger and the time they have left.
There's no reason for them to just turn back.

#C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF―――Sorry about this.
In place of my pathetic Master, I apologize for
this blunder, this accident.
Saying that, #C236196003Lancer#CDEF gently closes his eyes.

He had a purely dazzling, straight attitude for
one who was baptized clean of the many pesky signs we faced.

Also, #C236196003Jinako Carigiri#CDEF's messy room and this
merely-spacious Labyrinth aren't so different―
They consist of pointless size and fat.

Finding something here is like pulling out
unworn underwear from a pile of laundry―
a dreadful penance. I can sympathize.

A-all you've been doing is saying
whatever you want! Whose side are you on!?
Bodily speaking, I'm on your side.

Oooh, I was hoping you would say
"emotionally" on my side!

F-fine! Show me how a minor, Mahabarata or
Yogacurry or whatever Heroic Spirit like you
can be worth a single damn!

I shall do so if you command.
Our guests won't leave so readily.
At the very least, have a taste of my lance.

Goosebumps tingle over my skin.
In contrast to his gentle, closing remark, 
he swells in that instant with fighting spirit.

Take an extra step back than you usually do,
Master. It doesn't seem like I'll get any
chances to look behind.

This guy is trouble, Darling!
He definitely doesn't know what the
words "hold back" mean!

Hmph. Brave words. If such a feast suits my
palate, then I'll partake. Don't barrage us with
Noble Phantasms, or I'll cut you both down.

He shoots laser beams from his eyes―――
Yeah, my Servant is a special type!
A laser beam Heroic Spirit: a #C000246204Launcher#CDEF!

…#C236196003Lancer#CDEF, are you alright with that?
Your expression says you don't mind.
…I see, a #C000246204Launcher#CDEF, huh…

*kgh*, what horrible taste…!
Though it's not necessarily wrong,
it ticks me off even more…!

………I have no choice. Such is my fate for
having a Master of unique inclinations.
I don't mind being a #C000246204Launcher#CDEF from now on.

Look how understanding he is! And how he
puts on airs by not dealing the final blow.
He's the #ROFS0002#RUBS   slack#RUBEhandicap#REND a skilled person gives!

I had no intention on going easy.
They're not opponents that would go
down very quickly.

In showing my Master the capability of
our opponents, all I did was conclude that we
must take a second look at our approach.

I had forgotten what it was like to
fight a real Heroic Spirit
since coming to the #C000246204Far Side of the Moon#CDEF.

Acting all #RUBS      lenient  #RUBEhigh and mighty#REND, not even
smirking at them―what's up with you?
Your heart made outta sponge?

I don't mind. Even if the aquarium's manatee
turns into an earless seal, #C236196003BB#CDEF won't care.

More importantly―――Your true nature has
started showing an awful lot,
for a while now. Is that alright, Master?

A pain stabs at my left arm, intermittently―――
the sign of an #C000246204SG#CDEF.

It's clearly reacting to #C236196003Jinako#CDEF and Lanc…
#C236196003Launcher#CDEF's back and forth.
That overwhelming dominance had conversely
weakened her mental wall.

I can't afford to miss
this perfect chance to provoke her―――!
Jinako hasn't used up a single calorie, huh?
It's a rout… I don't feel we can win anymore.

My b-brain,
I'm working out my brain!
#C236196003Karna#CDEF#ROFS0004#RUBS     my errand boy for#RUBE is in charge#REND of my shopping!

Even though this is the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF―no,
because it is―thinking takes a lot of calories.
Don't make me say it, it's embarrassing.

I see… then I didn't even need this elaborate
setup in the first place. I should've done
something more simple.

I attack after farming as much experience from
mid-bosses and mini-bosses as possible, so I got
caught up in the grind―a bad habit of mine…

―――That's right. That's a habit of hers.
Everything on this floor was devised by #C236196003Jinako#CDEF.
Now I'm starting to get what her #C000246204SG#CDEF is about.
Suddenly they're all obvious lies.
What's she protecting with these lies?

Sorry my lies are so lame!
A strong person wouldn't understand, anyway.
Despite what they are, I needed them.

They're just lies.
What's wrong with that?
They're useful tools and tactics.

As long as these lies don't end up hurting
either you or me, then it's fine, isn't it!?
The truth is, you WANTED me to find out.

……wrong!
I'm telling you, you're WRONG!

#C236196003Jinako Carigiri#CDEF is different.
There's definitely something important to her.

…what are you saying?
Something important to me?
To ME?

Huh―? What are you, dumb!?
This is why brats like you are such a pain,
such amateurs…!

You don't understand anything!
You've got nothing to suffer about!

A lie to protect something important?
Only blessed winners with the luxury to
do so spout such BULLSHIT!

I have nothing that's important to me,
I have nothing about myself to be proud of!
Having her secret exposed, #C236196003Jinako#CDEF's offshoot vanishes.

We finished extracting her #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Now the Shield will be released.

…but, out of all the #C000246204SGs#CDEF I've extracted so far,
this one left the worst aftertaste.

…I confirmed the activation of the next floor.
As expected, there seem to be more hidden #C000246204SGs#CDEF.

#C236196003#NICK#CDEF―――Head on back.
You need to get your rest.

By the way, #C236196003Leo#CDEF, where did #C236196003Gatou#CDEF go?
Is he on the way back, by any chance?

It seems he had a pretty late start, completely
falling for the sign's messages over and over
and getting stuck.

What?
I can't tell if he's good at playing along
with people or just gullible.

Brother, if you can―after watering the flower
garden―can you get a Return Crystal to #C236196003Chief
Gatou#CDEF and tell him the Labyrinth is clear?

I understand, after I tend to the grounds,
right? …no, I might forget at that point.
I'll head out now.
#C236196003Gatou#CDEF… I wonder if he's alright.

There's one more person who's
thoroughly adept with people:
#C236196003Jinako#CDEF's Servant, Lanc―#C236196003Launcher#CDEF.

Though it naively looks like we managed
to turn this bad situation around,
the fact of the matter is that #C236196003Karna#CDEF's
confidence wasn't broken in the slightest.

Though the best thing would be if
#C236196003Jinako#CDEF gave up and started being honest…

Nothing will come out of thinking over this alone.
Let's start by #C000246204going back to my own room#CDEF.
